verdict.rationale: TruffleHog works across many targets at once. One invocation can scan an entire GitHub org (`--org`), and a single `core.hooksPath` setup applies pre-commit hooks to every repository with no per-repo work. Detector selection and verification overrides can also be set for many detectors in one command. Missing for 10: bulk actions on findings (e.g., batch triage, rotation or remediation), any documented bulk API (no OpenAPI spec was found), and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale batch workflows.
